notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-1.80.0.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Tu dien chung cua cong ty tren Google Sheets la nguon MAC DINH: may chua cau hinh (cai moi, hoac o "Tu dien" dang trong) se tu dung link Google Sheets + sheet TRANSLATION_MASTER, va tu tai + dong bo ngay lan dau mo addin - khong can bam gi. May da chon file/link rieng thi giu nguyen. - Sau "Tai tu link" / "Chon Excel", neu sheet da cau hinh co trong workbook thi tu dong bo luon (truoc day chi tu chay khi workbook co dung 1 sheet).
